items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So he started coming to my house. And three years after, when I was sixteen, we got married.

ctx.x: Her mother. So her mother told my mother that Louis' nephew was coming there to see me. So my mother said, "Well, you tell that boy that if he wants to (?), he can come to your house. See, I don't want you to be meeting boys on the street or sitting on somebody else's steps. See, I know you're too young; you're thirteen years old. But rather than have people talking about you, have that boy come...you know, he could come to the house."
So he started coming to my house. And three years after, when I was sixteen, we got married.
